phase_prompt.label: Default State
phase_prompt.summary: The populace exists in a state of high-latency resignation, observing the world with tired, data-weary eyes. They stand amidst the geometric ruins of the Surface Plane, illuminated by the cold, indifferent glow of the simulation boundaries.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium cinematic shot of a group of the People of the Earth, their faces illuminated by the cold, blueish light of a distant simulation gate. They stand motionless, wrapped in heavy, textured fabrics patched with tech-debris. The background is a blur of dark, geometric landscapes and atmospheric haze. The focus is sharp on their eyes, which convey a deep, systemic exhaustion. The image quality is pristine, resembling a high-budget drama production still, with subtle chromatic aberration at the edges.
